newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dexia to set up international unit -papers.
newsitem.headline: Dexia to set up international unit -papers.

text.p: Dexia, the joint banking operation between Credit Communal de Belgique and Credit Local de France, will set up a unit next year to develop its international activities, Belgian newspapers said on Tuesday.
"We have the means and a very clear vision of what we want," CCB chief executive Francois Narmon was quoted by francophone financial daily L'Echo as saying.

Narmon announced the unit would be set up, saying the new Dexia group must not be considered a "simple juxtaposition of CCB and CLF", L'Echo said. The new unit would deal essentially with developing activities in Europe.
L'Echo said Narmon did not rule out selling the five percent of CLF held by CCB in the future, but there were no immediate plans to do so.
"At the moment we are keeping it because we get a good return," Narmon was quoted as saying.
He added that CCB was therefore not behind the sale of close to five percent of CLF which was sold in a block on the Paris Bourse at the end of last week.
